tasks.title: Setup project structure and initialize React frontend with Node.js/Express backend
Create PostgreSQL database schema with users and tasks tables including indexes and relationships
Implement backend API endpoints for task CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete)
Build Task List Home screen with task cards, filter tabs, and FAB button
Implement Create Task modal with form validation and character count
Build Task Detail screen with mark complete and delete functionality
Implement task completion toggle with status update and completed tasks screen
Create Delete Confirmation Modal with warning UI and permanent deletion logic
Implement bottom navigation bar with routing between Tasks, Completed, and Profile screens
Build User Profile screen with account info and basic statistics display
Apply design system including color scheme, typography, and component styling
Implement toast notifications for user feedback on task actions
Add responsive design adjustments and accessibility features (WCAG 2.1 AA)
Perform end-to-end testing of all user flows and fix critical bugs

risks: Database connection issues or schema migration failures could delay backend development
Complex state management between task list and detail views may require refactoring
Tight timeline may force cutting accessibility features or responsive design optimizations
Single developer scenario increases risk of bottlenecks in full-stack implementation
Missing user authentication system may require quick implementation or mock solution for MVP
